title: A/R Collection shows a customer who only has a credit
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has no past-due invoice and one unused credit memo dated last week.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Collection" in the left list.
  3. Find customer X.
  4. Open customer X's group.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 3:

  • customer X is listed.

Step 4:

  • the credit memo is its only line.

Why this matters: A collector must see credits to apply before calling.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountReceivable/Service/DbalAccountReceivableCustomerFetcher.php:324-373. V1 code, quoted: `if ($pastDueOnly) { $qb->andWhere('TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, cm.date_created, :asOfDate) >= 0'); }`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-103) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Not yet checked against any build.

AUTOMATION: READY
